what-the-island-forgot.c2d2fc3f: What? Your hour is wrong? Then answer me this.
what-the-island-forgot.7ae2eff5: If it is always twelve, how many hours pass between one twelve and the next?
what-the-island-forgot.dd5e348f: None. Then I have been standing still. A city needs a real clock.
what-the-island-forgot.9b3feeb6: Wrong. Tick. Tock. Think about it. There is plenty of time.
what-the-island-forgot.e6bd31a4: Every tunnel on this island is mine, and nobody ever comes back to thank me.
what-the-island-forgot.2bc909e3: Prove your partner is worth a building.
what-the-island-forgot.715f93b8: I could build a whole district for someone like that.
what-the-island-forgot.b03fdfea: Shh. This seed only opens for someone patient.
what-the-island-forgot.410595ab: It woke up! I'm taking it somewhere safe.
what-the-island-forgot.099335f6: It likes sweet things. A {item Item.SweetNut} might wake it, if you ever find one.
what-the-island-forgot.6c6c90ec: I see everything from up here. Nobody ever asks.
what-the-island-forgot.f8b4aea5: Then I'm asking. What do you see?
what-the-island-forgot.b96781ea: Far off, File City. New roofs every week, and nobody keeping watch over them.
what-the-island-forgot.0b856b95: A lookout. Yes. I thought nobody would ever say it.
what-the-island-forgot.2788aab7: I'll be here. I see everything, remember.
what-the-island-forgot.d07db6da: I'm not moving. I'm too hungry to move. Is that meat I smell?
what-the-island-forgot.2a575e35: No? Then come back with a {item Item.Meat}. I'll be here. I told you, I'm not moving.
what-the-island-forgot.ba2a273b: Passes what? There's nothing behind you.
what-the-island-forgot.f0d4e971: My post is gone, but my oath is not. Name a wall and I will guard it.
what-the-island-forgot.5bbf4a04: Teach me? No, I'll teach you. Where's the Arena?
what-the-island-forgot.cb9cf481: I have stood here since before the ice.
what-the-island-forgot.6ea5b823: Still not the answer. But closer.
what-the-island-forgot.19af0bcd: The machine fell. I felt it even in here, behind the world.
what-the-island-forgot.b2c0196e: I guard nothing and I serve nobody. I only want to know what strength is for.
what-the-island-forgot.97404613: So that is what it is for.
what-the-island-forgot.2adde47a: Take these. I will be here when you want to ask me again.
what-the-island-forgot.7541f7c3: Cough, cough! What is all this dust?
what-the-island-forgot.804e2fb5: Spores. Nobody stays on their feet for long around me.
what-the-island-forgot.004d29e7: You're not sick. Interesting. I could learn medicine from you.
what-the-island-forgot.822f4a8a: I carry things for those who no longer need them.
what-the-island-forgot.051eaae4: Your name stays on my list a little longer. Do you have a shop for me?
what-the-island-forgot.6b9b0dab: Trick or treat! No? Then a game.
what-the-island-forgot.646fd99a: You don't scare easily. Good. I need customers like that.
what-the-island-forgot.53b5100b: Do you know how far I've fallen?
what-the-island-forgot.a010f6e5: Never mind. Want to see some stars?
what-the-island-forgot.adf0118b: A hit like that! The city must be full of stars.
what-the-island-forgot.5e462840: Zzz... a dream of flying... crunchy... a dream of home... sweet... zzz...
what-the-island-forgot.a9374b8e: Mmf? Who's there? Oh. You dream of a big city. I sell those.
what-the-island-forgot.8a4f3a0c: You have good shoulders. There is more rock in the city?
what-the-island-forgot.3f345b62: The words are leaving. I need someone who still remembers things.
what-the-island-forgot.65e20468: A whole city that remembers you? Then I will read there.
what-the-island-forgot.1d153f23: Come back when you have read more of this island.
what-the-island-forgot.31037e8b: That Gururumon isn't from around here... Is it looking for me?
what-the-island-forgot.2987bcdc: Ehehe! A human, a real human, in File City! Nobody out there knows yet...
what-the-island-forgot.fb477468: Want me to tell everyone? My rumours go suuuper far.
what-the-island-forgot.78981feb: The whole island would know by tomorrow!
what-the-island-forgot.26290e1b: Leave it to me! Everyone will hear about you. Eeeveryone!
what-the-island-forgot.2dc182c3: Okaaay. It'll be our secret, then. Ehehe.
what-the-island-forgot.f67dba4c: A tent, crates, a rusty generator... Somebody camped here. A long time ago.
what-the-island-forgot.f8d6c3f8: A notebook in the crate. Human writing again, but most of it's torn out.
what-the-island-forgot.819632a5: "Day 40. The ground changes here. It did not, last year."
what-the-island-forgot.8986bfdf: "Day 41. Half the crates gone. Nobody heard a thing."
what-the-island-forgot.148a1185: "Day 43. We go on north. CAMP 3 is under the plateau."
what-the-island-forgot.d3ae0dfc: The trail's blocked. We should open the road to the savanna first.
what-the-island-forgot.a7ea33ad: Nobody leaves this place with a name. Not them, not you.
what-the-island-forgot.244f3d37: I am not allowed a single mistake... and now...
what-the-island-forgot.81caa826: Hey. Hey! You're free now. The hunter's gone.
what-the-island-forgot.06646cc0: ...Grr? Where... I am Bearmon. I am Bearmon! I wrestle in the hills!
what-the-island-forgot.e4e3bd64: I had almost forgotten my own name.
what-the-island-forgot.6e399796: The lower trail is blocked. We need to open the way through the jungle first.
what-the-island-forgot.697c3d11: ...Yes. The human has come to the Seam. Small. With a Digimon.
what-the-island-forgot.ff04588b: Walks where the ground does not match.
what-the-island-forgot.55c9c165: ...As you say. I will keep watching.
what-the-island-forgot.8183f0b9: Who's it talking to? There's nobody here...
what-the-island-forgot.01eea4c3: Ogremon! What are you up to now?!
what-the-island-forgot.c4b0e9af: You again... You broke my canyon. My boys ran off.
what-the-island-forgot.2fda75f5: This cave's all I got left. Gweh!
what-the-island-forgot.a21d66b6: WaruSeadramon is still out there, in my sea.
what-the-island-forgot.e450192e: I could chase him far away. It would take me five days.
what-the-island-forgot.b33757e2: Then wait for me. In five days the sea will be quiet.
what-the-island-forgot.670c0ede: As you wish. But he will remember us.
what-the-island-forgot.a785b271: Before you go... I have something to tell you.
what-the-island-forgot.1fc06fb5: When I was young, the island grew.
what-the-island-forgot.b1d9fc03: The sea pulled back, and my cave ended up under new ground.
what-the-island-forgot.2cba785f: The old shore is still there, under the cliffs of Freezeland.
what-the-island-forgot.0637cb26: No one walks to it. I can swim you there.
what-the-island-forgot.b5fa7c46: Whamon's still out at sea, chasing WaruSeadramon. No ferry for now.
what-the-island-forgot.36b73d84: Whamon is still resting from the fight with WaruSeadramon. No ferry for now.
what-the-island-forgot.2ce7d520: Whoa... A ship! A real ship, like from my world. Stuck in the rocks.
what-the-island-forgot.b037cf21: There's a notebook in the planks. It's soaked... Almost all the ink's run.
what-the-island-forgot.b8df593b: "...the children were not supposed to come."
what-the-island-forgot.5d346343: Children? There were kids on this ship?
what-the-island-forgot.b5a8eb67: This was the shore, long ago. The sea pulled back when the island grew. I felt it go.
what-the-island-forgot.7fffab97: Remember me? You let me go. That was your mistake.
what-the-island-forgot.5ac45b30: Grrr... This sea is not big enough for me anymore...
what-the-island-forgot.b9a30a40: You called, and I came. So this is what lay beyond my ancestors' tablet.
what-the-island-forgot.df33810f: Look at the wall. Every kind of Digimon, in a ring around a mountain...
what-the-island-forgot.4d49a497: And outside the ring, those little ones. They look like... people.
what-the-island-forgot.09f9c0db: And the stone is in the old writing. Let me see...
what-the-island-forgot.372847ca: "They came from beyond. We stood as one at the center, and the center held."
what-the-island-forgot.664eeb62: "One of them would not raise a hand against us."
what-the-island-forgot.c26a9872: One of the people didn't fight? Then not all of them were bad.
what-the-island-forgot.be979cbb: It seems my ancestors remembered more than the island does now.
what-the-island-forgot.93609f16: I will keep watch on the savanna. Call me again if you need me.
what-the-island-forgot.0be6ebf0: Jijimon... I gave my key chain away. To him.
what-the-island-forgot.65850e25: Then the door has been used, my child.
what-the-island-forgot.a1ffb7eb: There is no ceremony I can do for you now.
what-the-island-forgot.b980fb44: My mom'll be worried. I know...
what-the-island-forgot.47282fd5: But somebody needed that door more than I did.
what-the-island-forgot.b6705e69: Mm, mm. Then let's begin a different ceremony.
what-the-island-forgot.fc079dc8: A house. Right here, in the city.
what-the-island-forgot.f0968078: Everyone, I had a really great time. ...And it's not over.
what-the-island-forgot.9485afab: The canyon is sinking, the ice is going, the old mansion has fallen in...
what-the-island-forgot.4f556845: The canyon, the ice, the mansion... all going back to how they were.
what-the-island-forgot.f456eb34: I feel... nothing coming. Is that good? I can't say why.
what-the-island-forgot.187e8d62: They say the ground in the canyon has stopped sinking.
what-the-island-forgot.1c7de4d5: And the Grey Lord's doors stand open now.
what-the-island-forgot.db264dfd: And Mr. M says Freezeland is thawing at the edges.
what-the-island-forgot.e02aff1b: That Airdramon was still breathing, my child.
what-the-island-forgot.bab5f71f: He has been mending in my house.
what-the-island-forgot.9ec9d4bc: A shadow of wings comes out of the smoke. Birdramon!
what-the-island-forgot.510eaf64: I carry anything, kid. Climb on.
what-the-island-forgot.6b8d3420: A light comes down through the smoke. Angemon!
what-the-island-forgot.892cb328: Wait! You can't hide inside the island anymore.
what-the-island-forgot.4b7a62bc: The canyon, the mansion, the ice... There's nowhere down for you to go.
what-the-island-forgot.1a1b6071: Then where...? Where do I go...?
what-the-island-forgot.66bfc214: My key chain... It's how I got here. Someone's waiting for me on the other side of it.
what-the-island-forgot.ec6f886a: Here! Take it! Someone's waiting for me on the other side. Go!
what-the-island-forgot.f7697860: The key chain flies into the light... and the light is gone.
what-the-island-forgot.ed70fc53: He didn't put it back. Then we will.
what-the-island-forgot.6c0eb514: {player}! Behold! It came back to me this very morning!
what-the-island-forgot.23d2543e: An angel. I was picturing an angel.
what-the-island-forgot.1a2e7251: Wings of light, standing over the ice... Now, why would I have forgotten that?
what-the-island-forgot.e3d984f1: The wall of ice runs down as water.
what-the-island-forgot.75439d45: Far away, all over the island, something is remembered.
what-the-island-forgot.f15e596f: I keep the door now. If you ever lose your way, come and see me.
what-the-island-forgot.fdcff459: The cold forgot me here. Is the sun still up?
what-the-island-forgot.24a2883f: Good. Then I am not the last one.
what-the-island-forgot.9464ae51: Then I'll go where the lights are.
what-the-island-forgot.0f140bf8: From under the pedestal, a cold voice:
what-the-island-forgot.28b4f159: There's more down there! Let's go, {partner}!
what-the-island-forgot.dd193b5a: You found it. The Wall of Hearts.
what-the-island-forgot.c611feed: Everything this island has forgotten is frozen here.
what-the-island-forgot.eb8b7db2: The old town, the old roads, the faces of friends who left for the cold.
what-the-island-forgot.4268e967: Whoa... That's what's in the ice? Can we get it out?
what-the-island-forgot.8ba3c2f1: I can open it. But the one who opens it must stay as its door.
what-the-island-forgot.6485ae91: You mean you'd never come back to the city?
what-the-island-forgot.62e6ada6: I would keep the door, here in the Sanctuary. And the island would remember.
what-the-island-forgot.035ec171: Choose, {player}. I will do as you say.
what-the-island-forgot.9854c20c: So be it. I offer up my soul.
what-the-island-forgot.ea75f24e: Then my place is in your city. The wall will wait.
what-the-island-forgot.669d4593: Hm? Somebody used to dig behind the hedge... There's only rubble now.
what-the-island-forgot.3e44e913: The gate's shut. Maybe a real builder could open it.
what-the-island-forgot.9a5c04d4: A thousand swings at the Ogre Fortress, and you still beat me.
what-the-island-forgot.3ac82d61: So I teach here now, and I wait for a tournament day.
what-the-island-forgot.27ac9d4c: Good! Now back to my thousand swings. Come back whenever you want another round.
what-the-island-forgot.d71847ca: Your guard dropped. Come back stronger.
what-the-island-forgot.dccc3d4e: Good evening. The day belongs to the fighters; the night, to me.
what-the-island-forgot.a528b466: I closed my collection. Now I study the living instead. Far more interesting, I find.
what-the-island-forgot.88d1969d: Birdramon flies, I write it down. From this window I see the whole city.
what-the-island-forgot.5b215c3f: Still nobody asks, but now I keep a log.
what-the-island-forgot.5d011e4e: Kid. You asked me once if I'd ever carried a human.
what-the-island-forgot.da07a531: I carried another one once. Up the mountain. For a fee...
what-the-island-forgot.7528eac9: I didn't ask what he was.
what-the-island-forgot.89eb16de: Long time ago. He paid, he went up. He never called for the ride down.
what-the-island-forgot.13feccf2: Ah-choo! Excuse me. On the mountain my spores made everyone sick.
what-the-island-forgot.0600e589: Here Centarumon lets me sell the cure.
what-the-island-forgot.993f4f99: Poop, poop, everywhere! For 1000 Bits I'll clean up the whole island.
what-the-island-forgot.fa44ad80: All gone! Not a single pile left on the island.
what-the-island-forgot.1d722213: Mm, mm... SkullGreymon walked into the square last night, all by himself.
what-the-island-forgot.58472008: He had his rest, Myotismon says. Nobody called him. He went straight to the Arena.
what-the-island-forgot.d866c771: Mm, mm... Angemon came back this morning, my child.
what-the-island-forgot.55497559: The ice has all run down, he says. A wall of water needs no door.
what-the-island-forgot.eb2cb460: Mm, mm... Something came back to me just now, my child. Something old.
what-the-island-forgot.e0046aae: The city remembers one thing it had forgotten.
what-the-island-forgot.031bd12a: The city remembers a few of the things it had forgotten. Keep going.
what-the-island-forgot.a08dc2ca: The city remembers many things it had forgotten now.
what-the-island-forgot.d16c9f8c: The old ones talk about it in the square.
what-the-island-forgot.561c7077: So much is coming back... Ho ho. I haven't felt this clear-headed in eighty years.
what-the-island-forgot.b210b778: I came for one {item Item.Meat} and stayed for the kitchen. Now I cook. I taste everything first, of course.
what-the-island-forgot.921a9a21: Digitamamon's eggs are the best on the island. I would know. I have eaten all of them.
what-the-island-forgot.c0ecb400: Their owners no longer need these. Psst... not everything here is on the list.
what-the-island-forgot.aaa0baf4: I carried the ice in on my back. Everything here was caught or picked this week and kept cold.
what-the-island-forgot.a5b98940: We painted the round window ourselves. From it I can almost see where I fell from.
what-the-island-forgot.159540c9: A box is a house once somebody waits for you in it.
what-the-island-forgot.10b9857a: I remember my name, I remember the hills. Every morning I say both out loud, just in case.
what-the-island-forgot.a166c55e: In the Lava Cave I nearly went out. Here I burn all day and make things that make you stronger.
what-the-island-forgot.c7df8bfa: Night watch. The map on the wall is the whole island, every road you have walked.
what-the-island-forgot.7ef6d09b: My oath outlived my door. This post watches the stairs.
what-the-island-forgot.9ea1ad25: Nobody comes up that I do not see.
what-the-island-forgot.e5ce35ce: Fresh from every corner of the island! The dreams are free. The fruit is not.
what-the-island-forgot.993c5f2c: Tapirmon sells the dreams. I keep the seeds safe.
what-the-island-forgot.d2037aec: Yours is growing. Everything grows here, even in the shade of a shed.
what-the-island-forgot.76b55b45: The cold forgot me, but the lights did not. I keep the big battery charged
what-the-island-forgot.f781f09c: so every lamp in the Works stays lit.
what-the-island-forgot.e92890be: Datamon files what is lost, and I read the files aloud.
what-the-island-forgot.42964069: In the Mansion the pages went blank. Here the words stay.
what-the-island-forgot.9353f1ee: Everything lost ends up in a file. Sell me what you have two of, buy what somebody else had two of.
what-the-island-forgot.c9168d02: Trick or treat? Here it is always treat, if you can pay.
what-the-island-forgot.803f54fd: Hot roots! Your partner will run twice as fast!
what-the-island-forgot.1d2b0ec6: Every stone of this yard I set myself.
what-the-island-forgot.55955972: In the tunnels nobody came back to thank me. Here you all walk on it.
what-the-island-forgot.7cf4ea35: Tick. Tock. Twelve, and this time it is true.
what-the-island-forgot.65ced7d6: Tick. Tock. It stopped being twelve, and I am so glad.
what-the-island-forgot.ac9f3a13: A city needs a real clock.
what-the-island-forgot.98e85238: Treasure! I swear there's treasure somewhere under this city!
what-the-island-forgot.2af647ac: This old well goes down a long way. I'm only checking.
challenge.home: Time to head back to the city. See you there!
armadillomon.challenge.intro1: You found me! I'm not the Armadillomon you beat in this valley long ago.
armadillomon.challenge.intro2: I've dug and trained every day since. I'm much stronger now. Want to see?
armadillomon.challenge.retry: Back for another round? I'm not going anywhere today. Ready this time?
armadillomon.challenge.won: Still not enough! I'll keep training. Here, I dug this up for you.
candlemon.challenge.intro1: I came back to the cave where my flame nearly went out. I'm not that little candle any more.
candlemon.challenge.intro2: I trained at the forge every day. My fire burns much hotter now. Want to feel it?
candlemon.challenge.retry: Back for more heat? My fire is still lit. Ready this time?
candlemon.challenge.won: You put me out again! I'll keep training. Take this, it's still warm.
gabumon.challenge.intro1: Back in the misty trees where we first met. I'm not the shy Gabumon you met long ago.
gabumon.challenge.intro2: I trained every day at the Treasure Hunt. I'm much stronger now. Want to see?
gabumon.challenge.retry: Back again? I'll wait in the mist all day. Ready this time?
gabumon.challenge.won: You're still the best! I'll keep training. Here, I found this in the mist.
digmon.challenge.intro1: Back in my old tunnel. I'm not the Digmon you met down here long ago.
digmon.challenge.intro2: Building the Works made me strong. Much stronger. Let's see what your partner is worth now.
digmon.challenge.retry: Back again? I'll be digging here all day. Ready this time?
digmon.challenge.won: Worth a whole district! I'll keep training. Take my spare drill.
starmon.challenge.intro1: Looking at the sky again. I'm not the Starmon you met on this ledge long ago.
starmon.challenge.intro2: I trained every night in the city. I shine much brighter now. Want to see some stars?
starmon.challenge.retry: Back for more stars? I'm here all day. Ready this time?
starmon.challenge.won: What a hit! I'll keep training. Here, a star to find your way.
leomon.challenge.intro1: The savanna. This is where we first crossed paths. I am not the Leomon you met long ago.
leomon.challenge.intro2: I trained every day in the city. I am much stronger now. Show me how far you have come.
leomon.challenge.retry: You came back. Good. I stay here all day. Ready now?
leomon.challenge.won: A true fighter's spirit. I will keep training. Take this, from my mane.
triceramon.challenge.intro1: This rock. It still goes there. I am not the Triceramon you met long ago.
triceramon.challenge.intro2: I pushed the forge's rock every day. I am much stronger now. Push back.
triceramon.challenge.retry: You came back. I stay here all day. Ready now?
triceramon.challenge.won: Good shoulders, still. I will keep training. Take my old helmet.
datamon.challenge.intro1: Your file says we met here long ago. That file is out of date.
datamon.challenge.intro2: I trained among the scrap every day. I am much stronger now. Let us update the record.
datamon.challenge.retry: Back again. I will be filing here all day. Ready this time?
datamon.challenge.won: Record updated. I will keep training. Here, a spare part from my files.
giromon.challenge.intro1: Factorial Town still hums the same old tune. I'm not the Giromon you met here long ago.
giromon.challenge.intro2: I trained every day at the Restaurant. I spin much faster now. Shall we dance?
giromon.challenge.retry: Back for another song? I'll be spinning here all day. Ready this time?
giromon.challenge.won: What a rhythm! I'll keep training. Here, a little ball from my jukebox.
monzaemon.challenge.intro1: The Robot House. This is where I came home to the toys. I'm not the Monzaemon you met long ago.
monzaemon.challenge.intro2: I trained every day at Jijimon's. I'm much stronger now. Let's play, with all my heart!
monzaemon.challenge.retry: Back to play again? I'll be here all day. Ready this time?
monzaemon.challenge.won: Such a strong heart! I'll keep training. Take this, it shines like a smile.
agumon.challenge.intro1: The Native Forest! I'm not the little Agumon who first met you here.
agumon.challenge.intro2: I trained every day at the Item Keeper's counter. I'm much stronger now. Let's fight!
agumon.challenge.retry: You came back! I'll wait right here all day. Ready this time?
agumon.challenge.won: Wow, you're still the best! I'll keep training. Take these claws, they're for you.
betamon.challenge.intro1: Ribbit! The mangroves feel just like old times. I'm not the Betamon you met here.
betamon.challenge.intro2: Running the shop taught me patience, and I trained in between. I'm much stronger now!
betamon.challenge.retry: Back again? I'm staying in the water here all day. Ready now?
betamon.challenge.won: Ribbit... you won fair and square. I'll keep training. Here, a full waterbottle.
greymon.challenge.intro1: A quiet forest, far from the arena's noise. I'm not the Greymon you once beat.
greymon.challenge.intro2: At the arena desk I watched the best fights and trained every day. I'm much stronger now.
greymon.challenge.retry: You returned. Good. I'll stand here all day. Ready this time?
greymon.challenge.won: Hah! That's a true fighter. I'll keep training. Take this metal part, it was my armour's.
tyrannomon.challenge.intro1: The cold wind of this glacier... I'm not the Tyrannomon you knew back then.
tyrannomon.challenge.intro2: Hauling crates at the Restaurant made me strong. Much stronger than before. Fight me!
